rows: Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase and carries out routine tasks, explains complex code and handles git workflows through natural-language commands. The same agent is available as IDE extensions for VS Code, Cursor and Windsurf, a desktop app via codex app, and the cloud-based Codex Web in ChatGPT.
